howto.text: Text appears as you change the options; Reroll shuffles it. The classic variant draws on Lorem Ipsum (Cicero's De Finibus, scrambled), the publishing industry's standard placeholder.

howto.name: Copy and use in your mockups

faq.q: Why use Lorem Ipsum and not English?
faq.a: It has roughly Latin letter frequencies so designs feel real, without distracting reviewers with the actual content. English placeholder text always gets read instead of looked at.
Not other languages or scripts. Besides classic Latin, it offers three themed word lists in English: Cyberpunk, Pirate and Hacker.
Cicero died in 43 BC. Public domain.
